evidence.quoted_text:
"manager_restarted": (
            (((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
             .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                 .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            and bool(((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and bool(((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")),
evidence.reason: At the current tip, `manager_restarted` only requires nonzero PIDs, a PID change, and nonempty/changed invocation IDs. It does not bind those before/after samples to the same guest boot. A guest reboot between the manager before and after snapshots would change both manager identifiers and falsely satisfy `manager_restarted`; the separate `boot_id_changed` predicate only proves the reboot test saw a reboot and does not constrain the manager check. Requiring equal, nonempty before/after boot IDs for `manager_restarted` is the smallest fix and preserves the separate reboot check.
